description: Cases for the PWA achievements (lib/logros.ts evaluarLogros/calcularRacha, lib/reconciliar-logros.ts, getLogroMetricas/listPRs in lib/repositories/stats.ts run on a seeded Dexie database) and the Android port (core:domain achievement/AchievementRules.kt, ReconcileAchievementsUseCase, core:data OfflineAchievementRepository). 'catalog', 'evaluate', 'streak' and every scenario's 'metrics', 'met', 'pwaNewlyUnlocked' and 'personalRecords' are what the TypeScript code returns. 'decisions' and 'storedAfter' are the APPROVED ANDROID outcome (see androidReconcile in scripts/export-domain-fixtures.mjs): the PWA never revokes an achievement, Android tombstones one whose evidence a history edit removed and revives it (same row) when re-earned. Steps of a scenario run in order against the same achievement rows; a step replaces the workout data (an edit) and is reconciled twice (the second run must write nothing). Rows with deletedAt are 'tombstoned'. Warm-up sets count, as in the PWA. volumenTotal travels as a number (finite in every case).

scenarios.name: sessions: edit removes then restores a session

steps.label: history edit deletes one session: sessions-10 is tombstoned
the session is restored: sessions-10 is re-earned on the same row

scenarios.name: streak: a missing week breaks the run, restoring it re-earns

steps.label: 12 weeks in a row earn every streak and 10 sessions
middle week emptied: best run is 6, racha-8 and racha-12 go
one kg less than 100k tombstones 100k and 500k

scenarios.name: mesocycle: completion is strict and tombstones follow deletion

steps.label: mesocycle deleted: planner achievement is tombstoned

scenarios.name: identity: PWA rows, duplicates, tombstones and unknown keys

steps.label: duplicate live rows are retained; tombstoned rows are revived (canonical id first, else lowest id)
evidence gone: every live duplicate is tombstoned, unknown keys stay
